description: This file defines a React functional component named Dashboard, which serves as a user interface for a career development dashboard. It displays KPIs, competency gaps, recent evidence, and quick actions, fetching data from various APIs and external systems (e.g., Supabase, custom API functions).

methods.name: deriveTraffic
methods.description: Determines traffic light status ('Green', 'Amber', 'Red') based on profile level and target thresholds.

methods.name: normalizeBreakdown
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a standardized Breakdown object with computed delta and traffic status.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Initial data fetching function that loads user info, profile, evidence, and analysis data for Dashboard display.

methods.name: onRefreshKpis
methods.description: Handles refresh of KPIs and gap analysis data when user triggers a manual refresh.

methods.name: onExportPdf
methods.description: Exports the current profile data as a PDF document.

methods.name: chip
methods.description: Helper component rendering a stylized info box for KPIs or labels.

methods.name: trafficDot
methods.description: Renders a colored dot indicating traffic status.
